About Obby Tsunami Runner

Run from the tsunami in Obby Tsunami Runner — a multiplayer browser game where every wave brings new danger. Dodge, survive, and earn wins to unlock characters and trails. Play as the legendary Tung-Tung-Tung Sahur! Compete with friends, push your limits, and see how far you can go. No downloads, just survival. Run. Unlock. Survive.
